description: This file implements the web ACM interface for CCSP TR-069 PA within a BroadWay Service Delivery System. It includes functions for initializing the interface and retrieving credentials for web access, interacting with global objects like g_pCcspCwmpCpeController.

methods.name: int ssp_BbhmInitWebAcmIf()
methods.description: Initializes the web ACM interface by setting its owner context, size, and the credential retrieval function.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ssp_BbhmWebAcmIfGetCredential(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pHostName,USHORT HostPort,PUCHAR pUriPath,PUCHAR pUserName,PUCHAR pRealm,PUCHAR * ppPassword)
methods.description: Retrieves the connection request username and password for a given host and URI, from the CCSP management server, and returns the password if credentials match.

ctags.name: ssp_BbhmWebAcmIfGetCredential
ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pHostName,USHORT HostPort,PUCHAR pUriPath,PUCHAR pUserName,PUCHAR pRealm,PUCHAR * ppPassword)
